entries.difference: Legacy re-encodes png, gif, jpg and jpeg uploads with ColdFusion's image engine into `_source`, `_small` and `_medium` renditions, and may replace the stored original with a resized copy (core/mura/content/file/processImgCfimage.cfc:266-320,371-417; core/mura/content/file/fileDAO.cfc:159-179, which also stores `_small` and `_medium` JPEGs for flv). Another encoder cannot reproduce those bytes.
entries.reason: Equivalence is impossible, so the `{upload=image}` variants stay `legacy-write` inside write windows, which import their originals and renditions into Cloud Storage for the target to serve byte for byte through `/_api/render`. Non-image uploads are carried.

entries.difference: Any request other than `method=processAsyncObject` whose query string carries the reload key (`application.appReloadKey`, default `appreload`) re-runs application start-up without authentication (core/appcfc/onApplicationStart_include.cfm:80,99; core/appcfc/onRequestStart_include.cfm:123-130).
entries.reason: Pre-existing weakness, reported and not fixed: the proposal is to require an authenticated S2 user or a secret, non-default reload key. The reload entry is `legacy-write` in every version, so the proposal never affects cut-over and is not activated this run.
